sql.prune: DELETE FROM n_github_oauth_flows WHERE expires_at <= LOCALTIMESTAMP
sql.callbackLock: SELECT flow_id,pkce_verifier FROM n_github_oauth_flows WHERE state_hash=:state_hash AND status='pending' AND expires_at>LOCALTIMESTAMP FOR UPDATE
sql.callbackClaim: UPDATE n_github_oauth_flows SET status='checking' WHERE flow_id=:flow_id AND status='pending'
sql.callbackFinish: UPDATE n_github_oauth_flows SET status=:status,github_user_id=:github_user_id,github_login=:github_login,pkce_verifier=NULL WHERE flow_id=:flow_id AND status='checking' AND expires_at>LOCALTIMESTAMP
sql.completeLock: SELECT status,github_user_id,github_login FROM n_github_oauth_flows WHERE flow_id=:flow_id AND flow_key_hash=:flow_key_hash AND purpose=:purpose AND expires_at>LOCALTIMESTAMP AND (purpose='login' OR (owner_user_id=:owner_user_id AND owner_session_id=:owner_session_id)) FOR UPDATE
sql.passkeyCount: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM n_webauthn_credentials WHERE user_id=:user_id
